name: Batch 24 · Colour, bounce and voices
status: Published to separate Spotify audition and atomically appended to hosted Playlist Lab. Thirty exact unrated candidates, corrected source-version note, prior feedback/history preservation and unchanged main Spotify orders verified.

selection_policy.authorization: Check Grove23 feedback and create another 30; host says the previous batch had too much swing/jazz. No predictive model.
selection_policy.method: Read all 136 actual canonical Grove Keeps and 886 Cuts. Broad recording-specific editorial comparisons across rhythmic indie, playful electro-pop, sensual electronic R&B and vocal dance. No deliberate swing/jazz choices and no new selections from the recent swing-focused artists; existing approvals remain intact.
selection_policy.brief: Upbeat, interesting, bouncy, melodic, sexy, fun, happy, hopeful and loving. Personality, hooks and development; avoid acid/techno, chart-pop/top-five-hit character, sad/negative stories, blandness, dragging repetition, fragments and artist/album concentration.
selection_policy.evidence_limit: No direct audio input supported. Published words, catalog identity and editorial musical hypotheses are distinct. No predictive model, metric fit gate, listening scores or inferred causal vote reasons.
selection_policy.source: Targeted discovery. Historical saved-pool options considered privately; no current global Like membership claimed.

feedback_basis.policy: Canonical feedback resolves host priority; preserve individual histories.
